ideas.text: An AI that translates 'competitive compensation' in a job posting into a realistic salary range.
A bot that tells you how long you'll actually spend on that '2-3 hour take-home assignment.'
An app that detects when a recruiter ghosted you and generates a polite follow-up for the third time.
A tool that predicts when a job posting has been open so long the role no longer exists as described.
An AI that converts 'we'll keep your resume on file' into 'no, but politely.'
A bot that detects when a job requires 10 years of experience in a technology that's 4 years old.
An app that tells you which of the 5 interviewers actually has veto power and optimizes your energy accordingly.
A tool that estimates how many other candidates are in the process based on scheduling speed and recruiter energy.
An AI that detects when a 'culture fit' interview is looking for personality fit with one specific person on the team.
A bot that detects when the hiring manager hasn't read your resume and sends them a 3-bullet summary before the call.
An app that generates a thank-you note for each interviewer without making all 4 sound like the same template.
A tool that detects when an offer's exploding deadline is designed to prevent you from comparing it to other offers.
An AI that translates 'we're moving quickly' into when you'll actually hear back, statistically.
A bot that detects when a job description was written by 6 different people with no agreement on what the role is.
An app that converts 'we're looking for a self-starter' into a list of what the team will actually not provide you.
A tool that detects when your application was rejected by an ATS that couldn't parse your resume's font.
An AI that generates 3 smart questions for an interview that show interest without revealing you have concerns already.
A bot that identifies when a panel interview question is really a test of whether you'll disagree with the panel.
An app that monitors hiring timelines and tells you when to negotiate, wait, or walk away.
A tool that compares your offer letter to the market rate and generates the counter-offer you're afraid to send.
An AI that detects when an interview question is illegal in your jurisdiction and suggests how to handle it.
A bot that translates a recruiter's 'we'll circle back by end of week' based on their historical follow-through rate.
An app that detects when a job's listed salary range has been the same for 2 years without adjustment for inflation.
A tool that identifies when a company is 'always hiring' because their turnover rate is structurally elevated.
An AI that evaluates whether a Glassdoor review was written by an actual employee or a suspicious fan of the CEO.
A bot that detects when a final-round rejection was made before your interview based on scheduling latency.
An app that converts 'we're a startup so things move fast' into a list of things that don't have a process yet.
A tool that detects when a reference check is a formality and when it's a genuine risk to your offer.
An AI that generates the email to ask for your rejected application feedback in a way that might actually get a response.
A bot that tells you whether a recruiter's message on LinkedIn is a real opportunity or a contact list expansion.
An app that detects when an offer package is designed to look bigger than it is through confusing equity language.
A tool that identifies which Glassdoor complaints appear in every review and are therefore structural, not personal.
An AI that detects when your counter-offer request is being stalled without a real response and names the pattern.
A bot that converts 'we're like a family here' into the 3 things that actually means for your vacation requests.
An app that estimates your probability of getting the job based on the energy of each interview, scored in real time.
A tool that detects when a hiring freeze was announced the same week as a job you were interviewing for.
An AI that generates a negotiation script for people who get sweaty palms when money comes up.
A bot that detects when two recruiters from the same company reached out about two different roles and coordinates your response.
An app that identifies when a 'values interview' is actually checking whether you'll work overtime without complaining.
A tool that detects when a job was posted internally first and the external posting is a formality.
An AI that translates the equity section of an offer letter into what you'd actually receive under realistic scenarios.
A bot that detects when an interview panel includes someone who will report to you and flags the power dynamic.
An app that estimates when a new hire's enthusiasm will hit its first reality check based on offer letter promises.
A tool that detects when a company's growth story relies on funding rather than revenue and asks what happens at the next round.
An AI that detects when you're being interviewed for a role the company hasn't budgeted for yet.
A bot that monitors your job search energy levels and tells you when to take a week off before you say something weird in an interview.
An app that detects when a job posting disappeared the day after you submitted your application.
A tool that identifies when a 'culture add' interview is just checking whether you went to the right school.
An AI that generates a follow-up to a great first interview that's warm without being the reason they reconsidered.
A bot that detects when 'we don't have a budget for that' means 'we have a budget but not for you specifically.'
An app that converts the first 3 weeks of a new job into a survival guide for navigating the unwritten rules.
A tool that detects when a new job's onboarding consists entirely of 'here's your laptop, figure it out.'
An AI that identifies when a company's values page describes aspirations rather than current behaviors.
A bot that detects when a rejection came faster than the interview could reasonably have been evaluated.
An app that generates the 90-day plan your new manager asked for even though no one told you what success looks like.
